title: Pilih arah SyntaxLab berikutnya
question: Arah ini memakai bentuk visual baru yang tidak muncul di dua putaran sebelumnya. Kunci kartu utama, alternatif, atau standar kategori.

options.label: Logic-Grid Study Sheet
options.lineage: Numbered puzzle-magazine grids and answer-key cross-references
options.thesis: Let learners scan a clean lesson grid, then open the exact explanation, example or exercise they need.
options.viewport: The first screen is a measured HTML study sheet: a narrow course index on the left, a 3-row-by-3-column lesson grid in the center with columns Konsep, Contoh, Coba, and an open current lesson on the right. The selected cell is “Pengenalan HTML / Konsep”; choosing Contoh opens the real starter code and browser preview, while Coba opens the existing exercises route. No solved/completed marks are implied.
options.risk: A puzzle grid can make ordinary lessons feel like a quiz; every cell must open real course content and the reading panel must remain primary.

raised.raise: Small code, labels and supporting explanations retain crisp pixel-level reproduction at their actual reading sizes; the grid never trades clarity for display type.
Topic tiles remain atomic and link directly to the matching lesson, while a whole-cell grid reflows without broken indices.
Selected, unavailable and current states use explicit shape and position as well as ink color, so state never depends on hue alone.

options.label: Chalkboard Lesson Studio
options.lineage: A classroom chalkboard with ruled diagrams and worked examples
options.thesis: Show one concept as a clear lesson diagram, then let the learner work through a matching example.
options.viewport: A large dark-green writing field presents one real HTML concept with a simple chalk structural diagram, a short explanation and a small editor/preview pair. A slim paper lesson list remains available at the side; a primary Coba example action leads directly to the playground.
options.risk: A chalkboard is a familiar teaching image and can feel generic unless the example-to-preview interaction owns the screen.

options.label: Course Wayfinding Bands
options.lineage: Airport decision-point signage and persistent route bands
options.thesis: Tell the learner where they are, what they can study next and the shortest route to it.
options.viewport: A compact strip at the top names the active route HTML; below, one lesson panel says “Pengenalan HTML” and a route band lists the next two actual HTML lessons. A second panel pairs a readable explanation with an HTML example and browser preview. One saturated yellow action says “Lanjutkan” and points to the actual next lesson.
options.case: It beats the assigned grid on immediate audience recognition and route clarity: navigation is explicit, and the next learnable step is unmistakable.
options.risk: Too many directional bands can compete with long explanations; signs should show only the current choice and the next lesson.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clear learning SaaS with a course catalog, a focused lesson view and an accessible live editor.
canonCard.viewport: A familiar navigation bar, plain-language “Belajar coding dari dasar” introduction, real course counts, and lesson pages with content beside code and preview.
canonCard.risk: Efficient and recognizable, but intentionally familiar to the category.
